historical_commentary.text: This FAQ covers TCP/IP basics, 4D's platform-specific 'network components' abstraction, port number usage, and troubleshooting steps for 4D Server and 4D Web Server connectivity circa v6/6.5. The general TCP/IP and port-number material remains conceptually accurate today, but the Mac-specific 'network components' abstraction described here was tied to classic Mac OS's pluggable networking stack (pre-dating Mac OS X's Unix-based, unified TCP/IP stack that arrived the following year), so that portion of the note is superseded, along with several of the 4D-version-specific port-number behaviors it documents.
related_updates: Mac OS X's Unix-based networking stack unified TCP/IP handling and obsoleted the classic Mac OS 'network components' concept this note explains
4D's own network configuration and port-handling behavior has been refined across many releases since v6.5
